fiscal.spending_origin: Proposed existing recurring obligations envelope, apportioned below. No unfunded recurrent injection. Aid payer is an unbuilt external resource-country account.

food.assumption: Opening inventory is already-paid household property. Households pay stable maritime food sellers from wage income outside the goods budget. External seller and settlement accounts are not implemented. Coverage assumes fixed population and uninterrupted imports, not a simulation result.

materials.assumption: Materials are paid from each future project capital budget, not a free treasury flow. Supplier prices and external accounts remain unbuilt. Two reference projects use the monthly flow exactly. Three projects burn four inventory units per month and exhaust the opening buffer after three months. Inventory is finite; heterogeneous projects require later calibration.
